steps.en: Install a pinned environment and prepare a local historical price file
steps.zh: 安装固定环境，准备本地历史价格文件

steps.en: Define a signal strategy and register the feed plus an analyzer
steps.zh: 定义信号策略，注册数据流和分析器

steps.en: Run the historical simulation with your chosen costs and sizing
steps.zh: 按选定费用和仓位运行历史模拟

steps.en: Advance the data clock and invoke strategy callbacks
steps.zh: 推进数据时钟，调用策略回调

steps.en: Simulate fills, update cash/positions and collect analyzer results
steps.zh: 模拟成交，更新现金／持仓并收集分析结果

steps.en: Inspect the returned analyzer data and validate the trading assumptions
steps.zh: 查看分析结果，核验交易假设

value.en: Strategy decisions have inspectable simulated orders and portfolio state, not live-profit proof
value.zh: 策略决策有可查模拟订单和组合状态，不等于实盘盈利证明
